access_links.label: gbXML schema, validator, sample files and test cases

description: Green Building XML (gbXML) is an XML schema that lets 3D building information models and architectural and engineering analysis software share building properties without re-entering them in each tool. It is sponsored by organisations including ASHRAE, the US Department of Energy, the National Renewable Energy Laboratory and Autodesk and, according to the site, has been the de facto industry schema for more than twenty years. The site offers the current schema version 8.01 and earlier versions, a list of supporting software, sample files, an online validator and viewer, current and prior test cases, and a validation test suite for vendors developed in ASHRAE Research Project 1810. Coverage: any building. Access: schema and tools on the website and GitHub. Licence: not stated on the page read; free. Caveats: export quality depends on the authoring tool, and the schema carries simplified analytical geometry. Simulation uses are moving building geometry, zones and constructions from BIM into energy and daylighting simulation. Related records: IFC and EnergyPlus.
